source_caption:
🎬 Land of Bad (2024)

Land of Bad follows Sergeant J.J. Kinney, a young U.S. Air Force combat controller whose mission in the Philippines turns into a desperate fight for survival after a military operation goes terribly wrong. Stranded deep in hostile territory with enemy forces closing in, Kinney must rely on his training, instincts, and the guidance of Captain Eddie “Reaper” Grimm, a drone pilot providing remote support from thousands of miles away. As the situation becomes increasingly dangerous, the two men must work together to survive overwhelming odds. Combining intense combat sequences, suspenseful rescues, and emotional storytelling, the film explores courage, teamwork, sacrifice, and the extraordinary pressure faced by soldiers in life-or-death situations.

🎭 Genre: Action • Thriller • War • Military

⭐ IMDb: 6.6/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 53m • R

🎥 Director: William Eubank

🏆 Recognition: Starring Liam Hemsworth, Russell Crowe, Luke Hemsworth, and Milo Ventimiglia, the film gained attention for its intense military action, realistic combat atmosphere, and suspenseful drone warfare sequences.

source_details.synopsis: Land of Bad is a 2024 American action thriller film directed by William Eubank, who co-wrote the script with David Frigerio. The film stars Liam Hemsworth, Russell Crowe, Luke Hemsworth, Ricky Whittle, and Milo Ventimiglia, and follows a US Army Delta Force team on a rescue operation that comes under attack from terrorists. Land of Bad was released theatrically on February 16, 2024. It grossed $7 million worldwide.
